params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: calculation
params.description: Constant (Listbox Footer Calculation theme) selecting the automatic calculation to perform.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the automatic calculation performed in the footer area of the designated list box, column footer, or all footers.

constraints: object can designate a footer area, a column (applies to that column's footer), or the whole list box (applies to all footers).
